title: Impressum Contact Data Extractor
description: Extract requested company details such as name, address, email, and phone from website legal notices when available. Batch domains and choose fields and language for each lookup.

batch.title: Domains
batch.description: Company website domains whose legal notice you want to inspect.
batch.valueDescription: domain checked for a German-language legal notice.

schema.description: The domain to search for impressum (e.g., example.com)
Comma-separated list of field names to extract (e.g., company_name,address,email,vat_id)
Language code for extracted values (e.g., de, en, fr). Country names and other localizable values will be returned in this language.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Extract company name, address, email, phone, and legal notice URL when available. Batch domains and choose requested fields and language for each website.
storeCopy.intro: Inspect a list of company domains for an Impressum or legal notice. Request company name, address, email, phone, and other supported fields, with values returned when the source provides them.
useCases: B2B teams can prepare company records from public legal notices.
Compliance analysts can check which contact fields a website publishes.
Researchers can map legal notice pages and company details across domains.
howToUse: Add one website domain to `domains` for each lookup.
Choose the comma-separated fields and an optional language for extracted values.
Set `maxResults` and export one contact record per domain.

faqs.question: Are all requested fields always present?
faqs.answer: No. A website may omit a field or use a different legal page format, so unavailable values can be null.

fields.name: success
fields.description: True when the German legal notice request returned a successful response.

fields.name: data
fields.description: German legal notice response payload for this legal notice record, including `company_name`, `address`, `email` and related source fields.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Error message or code returned by the request; null when the requested information was retrieved.

fields.name: error_code
fields.description: Error message or code returned by the request; null when the requested information was retrieved.

fields.name: impressum_url
fields.description: Public page URL identified as the website legal notice.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Phone number requested from the company legal notice; null when the website does not publish it.

fields.name: company_name
fields.description: Name or title assigned to this German legal notice legal notice record.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Postal address published in the website legal notice.

fields.name: email
fields.description: Contact email address published in the website legal notice.

fields.name: input_domain
fields.description: Domain submitted to retrieve this legal notice record.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this dataset record was collected.
